name: The Ruins of Stardust
summary: In Astranaar, Pelturas Whitemoon searches for a way to save his daughter, Relara. Elune's Tear eased her nightmares, yet a fierce fever still grips her. Orendil Broadleaf sends him south to find cooling stardust among the ancient night elven stones.

sections.title: A Father's Lingering Despair
sections.body: Pelturas Whitemoon keeps watch beside his daughter, Relara, as a malignant illness burns through her. Elune's Tear eased her nightmares, but the sickness remains. A fierce fever still racks her, beyond the reach of ordinary medicines. With the temple healers stretched thin, Pelturas turns to remedies drawn from nature and hopes to save her life.

sections.title: The Glint of Stardust
sections.body: Orendil Broadleaf, an elder herbalist, points Pelturas south across the river from Astranaar to the Ruins of Stardust. Frosted, shimmering dust gathers on plants among the fallen marble columns and archways of this ancient kaldorei sanctuary. Called stardust, the powder is naturally cold enough to draw out unnatural heat. Pelturas hopes to grind it into a poultice and ease Relara's fever.

sections.title: Prowlers in the Waters
sections.body: Water elementals and wildlife make gathering the frosted dust dangerous among the flooded stones. Corrupted or stirred by changes in Ashenvale's balance, the elementals surge around sunken plazas where the bushes grow thickest. You wade through shallows that look calm and watch for ambushes from the murky depths. The sparkling bushes must yield enough clean dust to carry back to Astranaar.

faq.answer: Relara, Pelturas Whitemoon's daughter, suffers from a severe fever in Astranaar. Elune's Tear eased her nightmares, but the fever remains. Orendil Broadleaf says frosted dust from the Ruins of Stardust can cool her in a poultice.

faq.q: Where are the Ruins of Stardust located?
faq.answer: The Ruins of Stardust lie south of Astranaar in central Ashenvale. Ancient, overgrown kaldorei stonework surrounds a small lake there.

faq.q: What is stardust in this context?
faq.answer: Stardust is frosted dust that gathers on vegetation by the lake. Pelturas hopes its cooling effect will ease his daughter's fever in a poultice.

faq.q: Does the stardust cure Relara completely?
faq.answer: Pelturas hopes a stardust poultice will lower Relara's fever. Whether it restores all her strength becomes clear after the treatment.

faq.q: What threats are found at the Ruins of Stardust?
aliases: what attacks at ruins of stardust
faq.answer: Aggressive water elementals lurk beneath the surface of the flooded ruins and defend the waters. They threaten anyone wading through the shallows to search the shimmering bushes.

Orendil Broadleaf is a night elf herbalist who lives in northern Ashenvale near Maestra's Post. He has studied the region's plants for centuries and advises Pelturas on rare botanical remedies when temple treatments fall short.

angles.text: As a night elf, you can see that the ruins south of Astranaar are remnants of ancient kaldorei civilization. Their lingering magic can still aid healing.
As a priest, you know Elune's grace soothed Relara's nightmares. Prayer may need earthly remedies beside it to preserve mortal life.
As a herbalist, you know that finding sparkling powder in the brush means recognizing rare plants in Ashenvale's damp places.
As a druid, you contend with perturbed water spirits in the flooded ruins to gather soothing stardust. Their presence speaks to Ashenvale's fragile balance.
